sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Floppy Fly is a simple game to play. The objective is to fly your character as far as possible while avoiding obstacles and collecting power-ups. The game's controls are easy to use, with a single tap or click required to make your character jump. The game also features a variety of power-ups, including boosts, shields, and magnets, which can be collected to help you progress through the game. One of the most challenging aspects of Floppy Fly is its increasing difficulty level. As you progress through the game, the obstacles become more frequent and harder to avoid, requiring you to think quickly and make split-second decisions to stay ahead.

The game's physics engine is also noteworthy, as it provides a realistic and immersive experience. The game's character movements and collisions are smooth and responsive, making it feel like you're really flying through the air. The game also features a variety of environments, each with its own unique challenges and obstacles. Whether you're flying through a dense forest, over a vast desert, or through a bustling city, the game's environments are varied and engaging, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.

Overall, Floppy Fly's core gameplay mechanics are engaging and challenging, making it a game that will keep you hooked for hours on end.
